notes: 1. Fixed losing the app after briefly visiting another website: navigating away used to be mistaken for closing the app, so the background server shut down after about 10 seconds and coming back showed a "Lost connection" banner whose "Retry now" button could not help. The server now waits up to 2 minutes before treating a goodbye as a real quit — returning within that window brings the app back instantly with all work intact. If you stay away longer, launching ODBCQueryApp.exe again reconnects the open page without a refresh.
